result_preview.description: This data product aggregates production incidents and safety incidents across manufacturing operations, providing comprehensive analytics on incident frequency, severity distribution, and safety compliance metrics. It summarizes incident patterns by equipment, location, and shift, enabling root cause identification and proactive safety risk mitigation to support continuous improvement in workplace safety performance.

Enables safety managers and executives to monitor compliance trends, identify high-risk areas, and benchmark performance against regulatory thresholds and industry standards.

result_preview.description: This data product aggregates incident and safety incident records throughout the production lifecycle to provide comprehensive safety metrics and compliance insights. The hub provides actionable analytics on incident patterns, root causes, and safety performance indicators across all manufacturing facilities.
